alt: 校園活動正熱烈展開，台上表演、台下準備，攤位前人潮不斷，到處都充滿投入的身影。
scene_prompt: 如火如荼 means an activity flourishing with energetic enthusiasm. Modern school community festival in full swing: at center a lively small stage has children performing a coordinated dance in simple modern clothes, nearby volunteers enthusiastically arrange handmade craft stalls, visitors gather eagerly, and a group prepares the next performance at the side. Rich clear sense of many activities progressing vigorously, a warm festive bustling atmosphere, no confusion or frantic failure. Small subdued warm-red and ivory bunting accents among natural green trees and pale blue sky, not oversaturated colors. No readable banners, signs, letters, numbers, logos, mascots, fire, war or branded costumes.
